semiconductor_relevance: High — Microtronic, Inc. specializes in automated macro defect inspection systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Microtronic, Inc. is a manufacturer of automated macro defect inspection equipment, wafer sorters, and metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their flagship product, EagleView, enhances yield and defect detection accuracy by inspecting over 3000 wafers per day, providing high-resolution images and detailed defect mapping.

regional_presence.United States: Microtronic, Inc. is based in Hawthorne, NY, serving the global semiconductor manufacturing market.
